\section[ekzámen]{\ru{экзамен} (ekzámen) — an exam}

\label{lesson:RU-C111-exam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Russian for a profession, then the Russian for a class.

Read \emph{\ru{аэропорт}, \ru{лифт}, \ru{метро}} aloud as one line, without stopping between the words.
\end{quote}
